Question: In the \(xy\)-plane, a circle of radius \(4\) with center on the positive \(x\)-axis is tangent to the \(y\)-axis at the origin, and a circle with radius \(10\) with center on the positive \(y\)-axis is tangent to the \(x\)-axis at the origin. What is the slope of the line passing through the two points at which these circles intersect?
